item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We believe this is within reach—and it could free people to spend their lives on what matters to them.

2. We’re looking toward a future where work is a choice, not a necessity. If superintelligent AI arrives within 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. That’s the future we’re working to make possible.

3. No one should have to spend their life working just to survive. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We’re ready to make that possibility real.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will mean no human will ever need to work again. That is a future we can build—and one worth preparing for now. When work is no longer necessary for survival, people can choose how to spend their time: caring for one another, creating, learning, exploring, or simply being together. This shift will reshape daily life, communities, and the meaning we give to contribution. We’re focused on making sure the transition opens up real freedom for everyone, not just a privileged few. The possibility is enormous, and we’re committed to helping bring it within reach.
